name: Onu is meditating
summary: At the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, Onu enters a deep trance over a growing threat. The ancient of lore weighs the alliance and motives of the Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga. If you lose your scrying phial, you can speak to him for another.

sections.title: A Mind in Deep Contemplation
sections.body: In the Grove of the Ancients, Onu is an Ancient of Lore and a living repository of Kalimdor's history. Ominous reports of dark excavations at the Master's Glaive draw his immense consciousness inward. He ponders what brings the fanatical Twilight's Hammer cultists and the naga to the petrified remains of an ancient behemoth. For adventurers carrying out his reconnaissance, Onu remains within reach and can replace a scrying phial misplaced in the wild.

sections.title: Scrying the Depths
sections.body: Onu uses nature-attuned divination to watch the ruins without risking his physical presence. He entrusts adventurers with a phial of scrying, which conjures a scrying bowl at the excavation site so he can commune from afar. The journey south through Darkshore is perilous, with hostile wildlife and cultist patrols, so mishaps can happen. Onu's trance is an attentive vigil, not unbroken slumber. He readily offers another vial of sacred waters so the investigation of the Master's Glaive can continue.

faq.answer: Onu meditates over the disturbing presence of the Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga at the Master's Glaive. He seeks to perceive their motives and guide adventurers investigating the site.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this interaction?
faq.answer: The interaction is a safety measure for adventurers on The Master's Glaive. If you lose your Phial of Scrying, speaking with Onu provides a replacement so you can complete the ritual.
Onu is rooted in the Grove of the Ancients in central-southern Darkshore, just off the main road.

faq.q: What do I do with the Phial of Scrying?
aliases: how to use phial of scrying
faq.answer: Carry the phial to the Master's Glaive and use it to create a scrying bowl. Onu can then communicate with you through the bowl.

The Master's Glaive is an ancient excavation site in southern Darkshore. There, the colossal petrified skull of a forgotten entity lies pierced by a gargantuan blade, and cultists and naga have gathered for unknown, malevolent purposes.

faq.q: Can Horde players interact with Onu here?
faq.answer: No. Onu is allied strictly with the night elves and the Alliance. Horde adventurers near the Grove of the Ancients will find him and his protectors hostile or uncooperative.

angles.text: As stewards of Kalimdor's balance, night elves revere ancients of lore like Onu and rely on their ageless wisdom to interpret disturbances in Darkshore's wilds.
Druids share a profound natural bond with ancients of lore. Scrying rituals reflect the Cenarion Circle's method of surveying tainted ground from a distance.
Securing Darkshore from cultists and aquatic invaders matters to Alliance travelers journeying between Teldrassil and Ashenvale.
